How to Play

You are Wick, the handy newcomer on Coppergate Lane. Help the townsfolk, gather friends, fight the clockwork critters of the Whistling Wilds and Gutter Gully, and get the Mayor's Golden Gear back from Big Bertha.

Exploring

Arrow keys / WASD walk. Space / Enter talks to the person or opens the chest in front of you; walking into them works too. On a phone, use the pad, or tap where you want to go. M opens the menu, H (or the ? button) says where to go next.

Talking

Click, tap or press Space to go on; number keys pick a choice. L shows the history, Q toggles auto, E skips ahead. The folk of the lane are all voiced.

Battles

Everyone acts in order of speed, shown at the top. Pick an action, then a target (tap the foe or the friend). Skills cost SP. Defend halves damage and restores a little SP. Foes fight differently: Cog Sprites swarm, Rust Crabs shell up and rust your armour, Lane Bandits pick your pocket (beat one to get the gold back), Gear-Wolves howl and go for the weakest friend. Watch for Big Bertha's wind-up: brace for it.

If the party falls, you can retry the battle at once, or be dragged home for a quarter of your gold.

Growing stronger

The party shares one level. Buy tools and gear at Bertram's stall and equip them in the menu; sell what you loot. A bed above the shop restores the party and saves. The game also saves itself whenever you change place.
